ship_platform.range_speed_mps.note: 0.0: paired with range_nm=0.0 for the same nuclear-propulsion unlimited-range reasoning

modeling_notes: Health scaled as one HP per metric tonne of full-load displacement, consistent with the DDG records' convention.

range_nm/range_speed_mps left at 0.0: nuclear propulsion gives the carrier no fuel-limited range (aviation fuel/stores resupply is handled via naval_stores/underway replenishment instead); no public range figure exists to encode here regardless, and the field would be misleading for a nuclear-powered hull.

naval_weapon_system.mounts[] models ESSM as 2 vls_sam mounts (matching the 2 physical Mk 29 launchers) and RAM as 2 ciws mounts (matching the 2 physical Mk 49 launchers) plus 3 separate Phalanx ciws mounts, for 7 total weapon mounts -- this granularity (one mount per physical launcher) follows the same one-mount-per-launcher convention used on the DDG records rather than collapsing all self-defense weapons into a single abstracted mount.

damage_model.hitboxes[] uses 4 zones (forward flight deck/catapults/hangar, island/radar/command, aft flight deck/catapults/arresting gear, reactor/propulsion/magazine) reflecting the carrier's much larger hull relative to the DDG's 3-4 zone pattern; component naming follows the corrected name/system-only DamageComponent schema (no hp field).

aviation_facilities recorded under _real_world per task instruction (catapults/arresting gear/elevators/sortie rates); these are documentation only, not engine-mechanized flight-deck-cycle fields, since no such mechanism exists in the schema beyond embarked_air_ops' single helo_unit_name.
